requirements.text: POST /orders accepts a request containing customerId and one or more lines, each with sku and a positive quantity.
Unknown SKUs and nonpositive quantities are rejected.
A successful request creates a CREATED order, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.

sources: CreateOrderService validates customer and order lines before saving the order. [provenance: /source_context/observations/0]
The supplied change publishes OrderCreated with the saved order identifier. [provenance: /source_context/observations/1]
